test_title: PYST 180: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 18th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97950a0fbbda3153a9f1070b3080296fda46d21eabff153efa3b65c7cb40249c.png]
solution:
The pattern follows here is:

 
• Circle is added from figure to figure in anti-clockwise.
 
• Slant line is rotated 45⁰ in clockwise and one slant line is added from figure to figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91f0fb471538a5334728f7a14653b0c0c32789d09285342c9804ca2f71767408.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"option 1".**
